title: fix(x): keep generated Control UI assets current
body:
Related: #171508

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes bundled-asset validation and Docker package preparation failing after X's Control UI fallback cleanup landed on main.

## User Impact

Builds can package the existing X Control UI source with matching immutable asset metadata. No new UI behavior, configuration, dependency, or package-identity exception is introduced.

## Why This Change Was Made

Commit670270edc060 changed X's browser source without refreshing its generated manifest. Regenerate its entry and stylesheet paths through the canonical builder. The strict dirty-source and generated-asset guards remain intact. Direct main publication was attempted for this proven baseline break and rejected by the PR-only ruleset.

## Evidence

- [Actual PR merge build](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38511985920/job/115682689459) identifies `extensions/x/openclaw.plugin.json` as stale; its sibling Docker job stops at the dirty-source guard before test lanes.
- An isolated exact CI base5c9d98d5 reproduction generates `df3cf5b4…`, while its manifest points to `e57c147e…`. The recovery PR's unmodified688e producer matches the old generation; its changes do not touch X or the builder's inputs.
- Canonical `scripts/build-plugin-control-ui.mts extensions/x` on current main regenerates exactly two paths. A second run preserves those bytes; formatting/whitespace checks pass. The intervening main rebase is disjoint from this producer. No new tests or full-suite replay are needed for the generated-only correction.
- Exact-head CI and ClawSweeper review are pending.
